VF EMPIRE · THE HOUSE-WIDE LAW

Everything we ship outlives us if it has to.

The Permanence Guarantee is VF Empire's written commitment on every product of the house. If VF ever discontinues a product, the source is released under a permissive open-source licence within 90 days, the last signed build stays verifiable in the public transparency log, and the sealed data format stays documented.

WHY IT EXISTS

The vendor decided.
We answered in advance.

The most repeated pain in software over the last two years is "the vendor decided". Belkin ended Wemo. Logitech ended POP. Neato ended its cloud. 23andMe entered Chapter 11 with seven million genomes as inventory. VF makes one commitment, in writing, that answers this before you buy. See the software thesis.

If VF discontinues a product, the source is opened, the last signed firmware remains verifiable in the transparency log, and the sealed vault format stays readable, permanently.

It is section 15 of the Terms of Service, enforceable in Malta courts and backed by an insurance-funded escrow for the source-release lane. Because every shipping binary is byte-reproducible from open source, the source drop reconstructs the product you bought.

The source.

We release the full source code under a permissive open-source licence within 90 days of any end-of-life announcement. Escrow-backed across two EU jurisdictions.

The firmware.

The last signed build remains verifiable in the public Merkle transparency log, forever. Third-party CI mirrors continue reproducibility checks after end of life.

The data.

The sealed vault format is documented in a public interoperability spec. Any conformant reader can extract your material, long after we stop building.

THE MECHANISM

Four parts,
each one checkable.

Each part of the guarantee rests on machinery that already exists in how VF builds and ships, described on the security page.

Written into the Terms of Service.

The guarantee is a contractual clause, enforceable in Malta courts, binding VF like any other clause in the Terms. VF Home carries it in the firmware licence.

Escrow across two EU jurisdictions.

The source-release lane is backed by an insurance-funded escrow held across two EU jurisdictions. The published Guardian Shield escrow deed names Malta and Ireland. If VF cannot execute the release, the escrow does.

Reproducible builds close the loop.

Every shipping binary is byte-for-byte reproducible from public source, and third-party CI mirrors in Berlin and Reykjavik compare their output against ours. The source drop therefore reconstructs the product you bought.

The transparency log outlasts the company.

Every signed release is entered in a public Merkle-tree log, with verification keys mirrored to Software Heritage and the Wayback Machine. A signature produced in 2029 will still verify in 2049, even if VF no longer exists. The Signing Infrastructure blueprint builds the same for clients.

PRODUCT BY PRODUCT

The baseline,
and where products go further.

The 90-day source release, the permanent transparency log and the documented data format are the house-wide baseline. Some products extend it.

Guardian ShieldFull mechanism published

Full source (Rust core, three clients, four backend services, CI and build toolchain) released within 90 days, escrowed in Malta and Ireland with insurance-funded execution. The vault format is a public spec at vf-privacy-kit/docs/vault-format.md with an open-source reference decryption implementation, and every version ships an "Export vault" lane. If the product ends, the pack distributor stays online for six months with signed daily updates. Documented in ADR-0013 and the escrow deed linked from the product page.

VF HomeHardware included

Source within 90 days, last firmware verifiable forever, hardware schematics published for the R·02 appliance, and a Home Assistant migration tool. See VF Home.

VF Legacy12-month guarantee

A 12-month guarantee, extended from the 90-day house baseline because an estate is a life event. The sealed vault format is documented in a public interop spec, with a migration path to national tools. See VF Legacy.

VF WalletBaseline

VF Wallet carries the guarantee alongside the breach warranty and a transparency log for every release.

Every other productBaseline

The baseline applies across the slate, from VF Mail to NAV·IT. At each launch VF reviews whether to graduate the repository to public with a proprietary licence and Permanence Guarantee auto-conversion.

THE CLAUSE NEXT TO IT

Discontinuation is one case.
Breach is the other.

The guarantee covers what happens if VF stops building. A separate warranty clause in the Terms of Service covers a material privacy breach.

On a material privacy breach the refund is automatic and a public post-mortem follows within 5 business days at /post-mortems/{id}. The clause is enforceable in Malta courts and backed by insurance-funded escrow. The security page describes the incident response, and the disclosure policy describes how researchers report findings and how the bug bounty pays them.

Commissioned systems are governed by the written agreement for that engagement (Terms, section 6), so ask for permanence terms in the statement of work when you commission a system.

QUESTIONS

Asked.
Answered.

What happens to my VF product if VF Empire shuts down?

Within 90 days of any end-of-life announcement VF releases the full source code under a permissive open-source licence, backed by an escrow across two EU jurisdictions that executes the release if VF cannot. The last signed build stays verifiable in the public transparency log and the sealed data format stays documented, so your data keeps opening.

Is the Permanence Guarantee legally binding?

Yes. It is section 15 of the Terms of Service, enforceable in Malta courts, with an insurance-funded escrow behind the source-release lane. For Guardian Shield the full mechanism and the escrow deed are published in the public repository. Commissioned systems are governed by their own written agreement, so their terms are set in the statement of work.

Will my data still open after a product reaches end of life?

Yes. Every product documents its sealed vault format in a public interoperability spec, so any conformant reader can extract your material. Guardian Shield publishes its format with an open-source reference decryption implementation and an export lane in every version; VF Legacy adds a migration path to national tools.

How do I verify the last signed build myself?

Every release is entered in a public Merkle-tree transparency log, with verification keys mirrored to Software Heritage and the Wayback Machine. Because builds are reproducible byte for byte from public source, you or a third-party mirror can rebuild the binary and compare it. The security page explains the 2-of-2 signing and the reproducibility receipts.

How is the guarantee different from the warranty?

The Permanence Guarantee covers discontinuation: source release, a verifiable last build and a documented data format. The warranty covers a material privacy breach while the product is live: an automatic refund plus a public post-mortem within 5 business days. Both are clauses in the Terms of Service, enforceable in Malta courts and backed by insurance-funded escrow.
